description: Execute a SQL query and write the full result to a file (csv or jsonl) instead of returning rows — use this for large exports that must not go through the model context. Relative file_path resolves under the export dir (default /tmp/db-access-mcp/exports); absolute or ~-prefixed paths must fall under the export dir or a configured allow_export_paths root. Parent directories are created. Existing files are not overwritten unless overwrite=true. postgres/mysql stream rows (no row limit by default); redshift/mssql buffer in memory and are capped at 100000 rows.

database.description: Database to export from; required when the connection declares multiple databases

file_path.description: Target file path: relative to the export dir, or absolute/~ under an allowed export root

format.description: Output format; default inferred from the file extension

max_rows.description: Optional row cap for the export

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (default false)

query.description: SQL text to execute (single statement for streamed dialects)

name: query_to_file
